# Package

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A physical package of a food product.

## Scope note

Unit of a Product as purchased; carries label and serving data as well as photo (front, back, and/or side).

## Broader

- [Food](../Food/) — generic (ISO 25964)
